name: ether
description: Local Ether 2.5 node canvas workflow control for Codex with node-role-channel graph, prompt, review, artifact, provider safety, media routing, and recovery guidance.

interface.longDescription: Create, inspect, edit, and explicitly run local Ether 2.5 workflow graphs through Codex, with focused skills for the node role channel model, multimodal media routing, prompt systems, review routing, artifact organization, provider safety, and recovery.

skillHighlights.useWhen: Apply exact Ether 2.5 channels, roles, Prompt family subnodes, connection role grid, and multimodal media routing rules.
Design graph topology, node roles, channel routing, templates, patch previews, and run previews.
Build Prompt family flows, connection roles, references, controls, presets, and variant strategy.
Build Compare, Evaluate, Filter, dry-run routing, manual override, and audit loops.
Organize six-channel asset imports, linked assets, copy and move flows, collections, lineage, and metadata.
Choose CLI, MCP, API, Simulation, or Experimental provider modes without hidden fallback.
Diagnose health, graph revisions, missing files, orphan artifacts, provider logs, and recovery actions.

defaultPrompt: Use Ether to create a new image workflow branch.
Inspect this Ether project graph before running anything.
Use $ether-connection-model to explain Ether 2.5 roles, channels, and media routing.
Use $ether-graph-architect to preview a graph patch for a new branch.
Use $ether-prompt-systems to design role-based prompt variants.
Use $ether-review-router to add a dry-run review funnel.
Use $ether-artifact-librarian to organize generated assets into collections.
Use $ether-provider-safety to explain the provider mode for this run.
Use $ether-recovery to inspect project health and propose recovery actions.
